setup: Standard chess; random secret drawbacks, but narrator can see his own.

opponent: Online human opponent (other color) plus Blue and Yellow bots.
win: Red wins by capturing Green's General. Green wins by losing its General to a bot's piece or by surviving 72 moves.
explain: An absurd four-army puzzle variant. As Red, hunt down Green's tough General before 72 moves pass; as Green, survive or get eaten by a bot.
notes: Very complex; details approximate from transcript.

setup: Narrator has a normal chess army; Fairy-Stockfish has 16 checkers pieces in a compressed setup (on both colors).

rules: Checkers pieces can't capture onto the edge (no jump-off squares), so the board edge is safe for chess pieces. Normal chess rules for the chess side.
win: Narrator wins by eliminating/capturing the checkers army; checkers side wins by checkmating/capturing the chess king.
explain: Your chess army takes on a horde of checkers pieces that jump diagonally. Use the safe board edges and wipe them out.
notes: Exact win condition for chess side inferred.
